obligations.action: take steps to ensure that any natural person acting under their authority who has access to personal data does not process them except on instructions from the controller
exceptions: unless he or she is required to do so by Union or Member State law

obligations.action: be informed of the appropriate safeguards pursuant to Article 46 relating to the transfer
obligations.condition: Where personal data are transferred to a third country or to an international organisation

obligations.action: present the request for consent
obligations.condition: If the data subject's consent is given in the context of a written declaration which also concerns other matters
obligations.constraint: in a manner which is clearly distinguishable from the other matters, in an intelligible and easily accessible form, using clear and plain language

qualifiers.text: Any part of such a declaration which constitutes an infringement of this Regulation shall not be binding
qualifiers.condition: part of the declaration constitutes an infringement of this Regulation
qualifiers.evidence_quote: Any part of such a declaration which constitutes an infringement of this Regulation shall not be binding

qualifiers.text: Paragraph 1 does not apply if the decision is necessary for entering into, or performance of, a contract between the data subject and a data controller
qualifiers.condition: the decision is necessary for entering into, or performance of, a contract between the data subject and a data controller
qualifiers.evidence_quote: is necessary for entering into, or performance of, a contract between the data subject and a data controller

qualifiers.text: Paragraph 1 does not apply if the decision is authorised by Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject and which also lays down suitable measures to safeguard the data subject's rights and freedoms and legitimate interests
qualifiers.condition: the decision is authorised by Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject and which also lays down suitable measures to safeguard the data subject's rights and freedoms and legitimate interests
qualifiers.evidence_quote: is authorised by Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject and which also lays down suitable measures to safeguard the data subject's rights and freedoms and legitimate interests

qualifiers.text: Paragraph 1 does not apply if the decision is based on the data subject's explicit consent
qualifiers.condition: the decision is based on the data subject's explicit consent
qualifiers.evidence_quote: is based on the data subject's explicit consent

obligations.action: engage, appoint, use or otherwise involve a Data Processor to process personal data on its behalf for any activity related to offering of goods or services to Data Principals
obtain from the Data Fiduciary a summary of personal data being processed and the processing activities undertaken with respect to such personal data
obligations.condition: Upon making to the Data Fiduciary a request in such manner as may be prescribed.

obligations.action: obtain from the Data Fiduciary the identities of all other Data Fiduciaries and Data Processors with whom the personal data has been shared
obligations.condition: Upon making to the Data Fiduciary a request in such manner as may be prescribed.
obligations.constraint: along with a description of the personal data so shared

obligations.action: obtain from the Data Fiduciary any other information related to the personal data of the Data Principal and its processing
obligations.condition: Upon making to the Data Fiduciary a request in such manner as may be prescribed.

qualifiers.text: Applies to the Data Fiduciary to whom the Data Principal has previously given consent, including consent under section 7(a)
qualifiers.evidence_quote: to whom she has previously given consent

qualifiers.text: Chapter II (except sub-sections (1) and (5) of section 8), Chapter III and section 16 do not apply where personal data is processed in the interest of prevention, detection, investigation or prosecution of any offence or contravention of any law in force in India
qualifiers.applies_to: Chapter II (except s.8(1) and s.8(5)), Chapter III and section 16
qualifiers.condition: personal data is processed in the interest of prevention, detection, investigation or prosecution of any offence or contravention of any law for the time being in force in India
qualifiers.evidence_quote: shall not apply where— personal data is processed in the interest of prevention, detection, investigation or prosecution of any offence or contravention of any law for the time being in force in India

qualifiers.text: The Act applies to the processing of digital personal data within the territory of India
qualifiers.condition: the personal data is collected in digital form, or in non-digital form and digitised subsequently
qualifiers.evidence_quote: apply to the processing of digital personal data within the territory of India where the personal data is collected–– (i) in digital form; or (ii) in non-digital form and digitised subsequently

obligations.action: publish the contact information on its website or app
obligations.condition: if a Data Protection Officer is applicable; otherwise a person able to answer on behalf of the Data Fiduciary

obligations.action: mention the contact information in every response to a communication for the exercise of the rights of a Data Principal under the Act
obligations.condition: if a Data Protection Officer is applicable; otherwise a person able to answer on behalf of the Data Fiduciary

obligations.action: transfer personal data processed under the Act outside the territory of India
obligations.constraint: subject to the Data Fiduciary meeting the requirements specified by the Central Government

obligations.action: meet the requirements specified by the Central Government by general or special order
obligations.condition: in respect of making such personal data available to any foreign State, or to any person or entity under the control of or any agency of such a State

qualifiers.text: The provisions of the Act do not apply to processing of personal data necessary for research, archiving or statistical purposes
qualifiers.condition: it is carried on in accordance with the standards specified in Second Schedule
qualifiers.evidence_quote: The provisions of the Act shall not apply to the processing of personal data necessary for research, archiving or statistical purposes if it is carried on in accordance with the standards specified in Second Schedule.

obligations.action: undertake a Data Protection Impact Assessment
obligations.constraint: once in every period of twelve months from the date on which it is notified as such or is included in the class of Data Fiduciaries notified as such

obligations.action: undertake an audit
obligations.constraint: once in every period of twelve months from the date on which it is notified as such or is included in the class of Data Fiduciaries notified as such; to ensure effective observance of the provisions of this Act and the rules made thereunder

obligations.action: request that a business delete any personal information about the consumer which the business has collected from the consumer

enter into an agreement with the third party, service provider, or contractor that grants the business the right, upon notice, including under paragraph (4), to take reasonable and appropriate steps to stop and remediate unauthorized use of personal information
obligations.condition: A business that collects a consumer’s personal information and that sells that personal information to, or shares it with, a third party or that discloses it to a service provider or contractor for a business purpose
obligations.constraint: The right granted must be exercisable upon notice, including under paragraph (4), and the steps must be reasonable and appropriate.

obligations.actor: person authorized by the business to collect personal information
obligations.action: only use that consumer’s personal information for a business purpose specified by the business
obligations.condition: A business communicates a consumer’s opt-out request to any person authorized by the business to collect personal information; applies thereafter.
exceptions: as otherwise permitted by this title

obligations.actor: person authorized by the business to collect personal information
obligations.action: sell or share the personal information
obligations.condition: A business communicates a consumer’s opt-out request to any person authorized by the business to collect personal information; applies thereafter.

obligations.actor: person authorized by the business to collect personal information
obligations.action: retain, use, or disclose that consumer’s personal information for any purpose other than the specific purpose of performing the services offered to the business
obligations.condition: A business communicates a consumer’s opt-out request to any person authorized by the business to collect personal information; applies thereafter.

obligations.actor: person authorized by the business to collect personal information
obligations.action: retain, use, or disclose that consumer’s personal information outside of the direct business relationship between the person and the business
obligations.condition: A business communicates a consumer’s opt-out request to any person authorized by the business to collect personal information; applies thereafter.

obligations.actor: person authorized by the business to collect personal information
obligations.action: retain, use, or disclose that consumer’s personal information for a commercial purpose other than providing the services to the business
obligations.condition: A business communicates a consumer’s opt-out request to any person authorized by the business to collect personal information; applies thereafter.

obligations.action: reidentify, or attempt to reidentify, information
obligations.data_category: information that has met the requirements of paragraph (4) of subdivision (a) of Section 1798.146
exceptions: Research, as defined in Section 164.501 of Title 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations, that is conducted in accordance with Part 46 of Title 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations, the Federal Policy for the Protection of Human Subjects, also known as the Common Rule
